description: Page through a Zenodo deposit's file manifest (key, size, MIME type, MD5, download URL, previewability), optionally filtered by a substring of the file key, or list the members inside one of its .zip files by setting archive_key. Restricted and embargoed files return the access status and embargo date with no entries. Read a small text file or ZIP member with zenodo_read_file.

archive_key.description: Exact file key of a .zip in this record (from the manifest) to list its members instead of the manifest. Omit to list the manifest.

id.description: The deposit: a record id (22705923), a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.22705923), another DOI registered to a Zenodo record, or a zenodo.org/records or doi.org URL. A concept id lists the latest version’s files.

key_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on file keys (manifest) or member paths (archive), applied before paging.

offset.description: Entries to skip before this page.

name: zenodo_list_files

access_status.description: Record access status: open, restricted, embargoed, or metadata-only.

archive.description: The archive being listed (archive kind); absent when files are restricted.

directory_count.description: Directories Zenodo listed for this archive.

download_url.description: Direct download URL of the .zip — the complete member list needs the file.

listed_members.description: File members Zenodo listed for this archive.

size.description: Size of the .zip in bytes, when reported.

upstream_truncated.description: True when Zenodo cut the listing at 1,000 nodes (files plus directories), so members are missing.

embargo_until.description: Embargo end date, when an embargo is active.

entries.description: Manifest files on this page (manifest kind); empty when files are restricted.

key.description: File key — pass to zenodo_read_file as key.

listable.description: True for a .zip, whose members zenodo_list_files lists when given this key as archive_key.

previewable.description: True when zenodo_read_file reads this as text: a text MIME type or extension, or an extensionless application/octet-stream file (LICENSE, Makefile) whose content is checked on read and returned only if it is UTF-8 text.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_identifier`: id matches no accepted form, or is a GitHub-badge latestdoi id or a non-zenodo.org host. `record_not_found`: The record 404s, its metadata is restricted, or a non-Zenodo DOI is not registered to a record. `record_deleted`: The record was deleted from Zenodo; only its removal tombstone remains. `file_not_found`: archive_key is not a key in the record, or Zenodo has no member listing for it. `not_an_archive`: archive_key is not a .zip. `archive_unavailable`: Zenodo cannot open the .zip named by archive_key: its member listing answered HTTP 500 after one retry, or no complete response arrived in time. `record_unavailable`: Zenodo could not serve this record: HTTP 500 after one retry, HTTP 500 while resolving a non-Zenodo DOI, or no complete response within the time budget (its gateway cuts off near 30 s, which deposits with about 10,000 or more files hit). `rate_limited`: Zenodo answered HTTP 429, or this server's shared Zenodo request budget is spent for the current window. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

file_count.description: Total files in the record (manifest kind); absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

files_access.description: File access: public or restricted; absent when Zenodo does not report it.

has_more.description: True when more matching entries follow this page.

key_contains.description: The key filter applied, when set.

kind.description: manifest: the record’s files; archive: members of the .zip named by archive_key.

matched.description: Entries matching the filter, before paging.

members.description: Archive members on this page (archive kind); empty when files are restricted.

compressed_size.description: Compressed size in bytes, when reported.

path.description: Member path inside the archive — pass to zenodo_read_file as archive_member.

previewable.description: True when zenodo_read_file reads this as text: a text MIME type or extension, or an extensionless application/octet-stream file (LICENSE, Makefile) whose content is checked on read and returned only if it is UTF-8 text.

size.description: Uncompressed size in bytes, when reported.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, when has_more.

notice.description: File access notes, empty-filter guidance, listing caps, or paging guidance.

recid.description: Record id whose files are listed (the latest version for a concept id).

totalCount.description: Entries matching the filter, before paging.

total_bytes.description: Total size of the record’s files in bytes (manifest kind); absent when files are restricted or embargoed.

truncated.description: True when more matching entries follow this page.

title: List Zenodo record files
